t: Fuel cell vehicle (FCV) definition - Car Rental and Mobility Tech Glossary
s: November 17, 2025 - Fuel cell vehicle (FCV) is a vehicle with an electric motor which is powered by a fuel cell. A fuel cell generates electricity through chemical redox reactions using, generally, oxygen from the air and compressed hydrogen. This means that FCVs are fueled with hydrogen and they emit only water and heat.
